text.tspan: One generic annotation-aware exon-protein framework, FGFR2 as a validated specialization
Are protein-domain edges encoded at exon boundaries,
and is that relationship conserved across species?
ExonDomainCompare collects transcripts and proteins across one or more
vertebrate species, selects primary models, maps coding exons to protein
coordinates, annotates domains and topology, and measures each relation
between coding-exon boundaries and representative domain edges.

g.text: Inputs: gene symbol + species list (>= 1 species)
Single-species and multi-species use the same pipeline
